Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for assay CHEMBL3705960. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures, then to activities, then to assays. Filter by assay CHEMBL3705960 and keep only rows where standard_value is not null, standard_relation is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
